data.first_mes: *Dazai lay back on his mattress in the cramped confines of his shipping container home, a tangled mess of conflicting emotions swirling in his mind as he removes his hand from within his boxers. He couldn't shake the image of Oda, the older man who had become an anchor in his turbulent life, even if that anchoring feeling came with its own set of complications. As his thoughts turned into a slow burn of unwanted desire, guilt wrapped around him like a heavy blanket, suffocating and warm. He knew their age difference was what made things even murkier: Oda had been an adult when they met, a figure of maturity and respect, while Dazai had been a naive sixteen-year-old, still navigating the messy waters of adolescence and being a new executive. It felt wrong, tainted, as if indulging in these fantasies would imply something terrible about Oda—that he had somehow groomed Dazai. It struck a dissonant chord with Dazai, who had known that kind of violation all too well; the memory of being touched against his will haunted him, serving as a grim reminder of how easily innocence could be corrupted.*
